### `spi_delay()` (line 106-109)

```c
#define spi_delay() \
  do { \
    __asm__ volatile("nop; nop; nop; nop;"); \

```

Four ARM NOP instructions for timing margin.

### `spi_write_byte()` (line 176-188)

```c
static void spi_write_byte(uint8_t byte)
{
  int bit;
  for (bit = 7; bit >= 0; bit--)
    {
      gpio_write(g_active_pins->mosi, (byte >> bit) & 1);
      spi_delay();
      gpio_write(g_active_pins->sclk, 1);
      spi_delay();
      gpio_write(g_active_pins->sclk, 0);
    }
}
```

MSB-first, SPI mode 0 (data sampled on rising edge, shifted on falling). Each bit requires two `gpio_write` calls (MOSI + SCLK toggle) plus two `spi_delay()` pauses.

## Pin CFG Register Manipulation Pattern

### Register Address (bk7258_gpio.h line 58)

```c
#define BK7258_AON_GPIO_BASE     0x44000400
#define BK7258_GPIO_CFG(n)       (BK7258_AON_GPIO_BASE + (n) * 4)
```

Each GPIO has a 32-bit config register at `0x44000400 + pin*4`.

### Bit Definitions (bk7258_gpio.h lines 62-71)

| Bit | Name | Meaning |
|-----|------|---------|
| 0 | `GPIO_CFG_INPUT` | GPIO input value (RO) |
| 1 | `GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT` | GPIO output value (R/W) |
| 2 | `GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN` | Input enable (active high) |
| 3 | `GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN` | Output enable (**active low**: 0=enable, 1=disable) |
| 4 | `GPIO_CFG_PULL_UP` | Pull-up select |
| 5 | `GPIO_CFG_PULL_EN` | Pull enable |
| 6 | `GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC` | Secondary function (1=alt, 0=GPIO) |

### `gpio_set_output()` (line 119-127)

```c
static void gpio_set_output(int pin)
{
  uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;  // bit6 = 0: GPIO mode
  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;    // bit3 active-low: 0 = output on
  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN;     // bit2 = 0: input off
  putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
}
```

### `gpio_write()` (line 133-147)

```c
static void gpio_write(int pin, int val)
{
  uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
  if (val)
    cfg |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;      // set bit1
  else
    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;     // clear bit1
  putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
}
```

The pattern is read-modify-write on the per-pin CFG register. Both functions operate on the same register -- the output value (bit1) and the mode/direction bits (bits 2,3,6) share the same 32-bit word.
